svg.title: Use DeepWiki to check how two files fit together
svg.desc: A repository diagram shows how files in a project are connected. Open the code to check what an arrow means. Read the map. Find the file that uses a value and the file that supplies it. Follow the link. Open the line in the first file that asks for the value. Verify. Open the source file at the same saved version. Check which value the code actually reads.
